pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions during active drawdown; pyramiding is limited to profitable momentum legs with a trailing stop locking in breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volatility-adjusted ATR breakout confirmation and zero high-impact macroeconomic news in a 15-minute window prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops and partial profit sweeps as soon as open trade profit hits $15, ensuring target asymmetry of $15-$30+.
